art.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: premium Korean fantasy RPG limited-event magical wish lamp, transparent PNG cutout for layered PixiJS animation. Primary request: a spectacular genie-style wishing lamp, a single complete lamp only. Sculpted luminous warm gold and aged rose-gold metal, elegant long curved spout pointing to the upper left, ornate open loop handle on the right, jewel-tipped lid, deep magenta enamel and restrained opal inlays, engraved arabesque filigree with tasteful high-end material hierarchy. Refined hand-painted 2D game illustration, jewel-like highlights, clear silhouette readable at 320px, gorgeous concentrated detail, not photographic, not cartoon emoji. Three-quarter elevated view, whole object centered and fully inside frame with generous clear margins, 1536x1024 landscape. Delicate pink magical light emerging from the spout, short faint whiff only; the main smoke and energy will be animated separately. Real transparent alpha background, no floor, no scene, no pedestal, no cast shadow rectangle, no floating extra objects. No humans, no genie figure, no lettering, no words, no logo, no frame, no watermark. The object should occupy about 75 percent width, retain crisp finely painted edges and a visibly hollow handle. Luxurious luminous pink and golden mood.
